description: Asset, threat, boundary, control, implementation, test, residual risk. One row per attack path the estate has actually closed or knowingly left open. A row whose implementation or test path does not exist fails security/test-matrix.mjs, so this cannot drift into a description of a system that is not here.

rows.control: every state-changing action requires a named permission on a bound principal
the projection role holds no write grant; enforced by the database, not the application
row security ENABLED and FORCED, no application role carries BYPASSRLS
append-only hash chain, Ed25519 signatures, and an anchor that catches truncation

rows.threat: the visualiser becomes a vulnerability map
rows.control: the producer sees paths and advisory ids; the plane receives counts and states only

rows.threat: SSRF into the cloud metadata service
rows.control: resolve first, refuse every non-public address, then pin the socket to the verified address
rows.residual_note: The policy is implemented and wired into the one outbound path in this repository. The 92 catalogued capabilities that reach third parties live in other repositories and are not yet held to it.

rows.threat: a compromised CDN replaces the renderer
rows.control: version pinned, bytes bound by sha384, crossorigin so the check is enforced
every data interpolation routes through an escaping helper; proved by injecting 2,868 payloads

rows.threat: a nested response denies the surface
rows.control: depth-bounded walk that reports the bound as a typed non-success

rows.threat: an unknown renders as a value
rows.control: a non-success carries no value field, so there is nowhere to put a zero

rows.threat: a dependency install script runs with the runner's access
rows.control: npm ci --ignore-scripts in every job that installs
rows.residual_note: Checked rather than reviewed: every npm install line in the workflow must carry --ignore-scripts.

rows.threat: an action tag is repointed at new code
rows.control: every action pinned by commit SHA; the workflow token is contents:read and not persisted
rows.residual_note: Checked rather than reviewed: every action must be pinned by a 40-character commit, the token must be contents:read, and every checkout must drop it.

rows.control: audit at high, with assessed exceptions that expire; unassessed, expired and stale entries all fail
rows.residual_note: 17 advisories are accepted on a reachability assessment rather than fixed. All are transitive through kepler.gl with no non-breaking upgrade.

rows.control: shape-based scanner over every file, exemptions written in place
rows.residual_note: The scanner now has a test of its own behaviour: planted credential material is found, an in-place exemption is honoured, and ordinary code is not a finding.

rows.threat: the proof silently does not run
rows.control: the suite fails when no database is reachable rather than skipping
